title: fix(pm): check-widening-tells reads the member’s PRIOR schema — a bound inside a previously-z.unknown() bag is not a new key
body:
Fixes #19099

Clause-②: no — one file under `scripts/pm/**`. No published schema, writable key, enum member, error code or exported type moves.

`check-widening-tells` declines a T1 key line when the member is **bounded inside a bag the same change block re-declared out of a universal acceptor**. The matcher read the added key TEXT and never the member's prior schema, so it could not tell a bag-internal bound from a new key — and the card's consequence followed: on this board the criterion-honest `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` was the blocked declaration.

---

## ⛔ This body was REPLACED WHOLESALE by the seat at 2026-09-19T01:54Z, for head `fa8321b2fa`

The first cut of this PR was reviewed at tier and **FAILED** on two BLOCKING findings (record: comment `5738054799`). Its one-line verdict: *the arithmetic is right; the identity model behind fact 2 is what leaks.* The body written at creation asserted the justification the review proved false, so it is replaced rather than patched; ⛔ what it used to claim is preserved as HISTORY at the end.

The delivering dev writes a body once and ⛔ does not patch it; the rewrite is the seat's act.

## The two findings, and how each is closed AT THE READING

**⛔ F1 — fact 2 was NAME identity inside the change block.** A same-named universal acceptor removed ANYWHERE in the block certified a bag at a **different path**, so "every value the new bag admits was admitted before" was false whenever the bag did not sit where the removed key sat. Three git-emitted diffs had base exit 4 / head exit 0, each letting a `strictObject` gain a spelling. ⭐ Worse than the #16943 quiet direction it resembles: that budget is **bounded** (one unit per removed line), while this decline silenced **every member of the bag, unbounded**.

⇒ **identity is now a PLACE.** The frames the hunk shows open **where each line BEGINS**, compared opener-for-opener and head-text-for-head-text, **plus the two lines' indentation**. #18234's SPEND path reads the same composed predicate, so it takes the same place — the prior review's F3 is covered by the same change rather than left as a sibling hole.

**⛔ F2 — a regex literal could hold a closed `{` open.** `enclosingDelimiters` lexes no regex literal and pops **type-blind** (a `)` pops a `{`), so a regex with net ≥ +2 unmatched openers inside the re-declared bag ate the bag's real closers and a genuinely **NEW OUTER key** read as a member inside it.

⇒ **the walk now carries an `unreadable` flag**, the way `readToCloser` already does. Every reader that **SUPPRESSES** a tell refuses when it is set; the firing-only readers (`enclosingDelimiter`, `inParameterList`) are byte-identical, so no removed parameter starts earning budget it does not earn today. **Absent path evidence answers `false`** — a caller that forgets to pass it keeps the tell **firing** rather than silently restoring the reading this repairs.

⚠️ **The flag is deliberately COARSE and that is disclosed, not hidden:** a division operator raises it too, and every line after it in the same hunk loses its delimiter evidence. That is the loud direction for the suppressing readers and byte-identical for the firing-only ones. A real regex lexer would need the preceding token — one more guess inside a reader whose safety property is that it makes none.

## Reproduced first, through THREE gates

Every probe is a **git-emitted** diff (a throwaway repo, real files, `git diff`) — ⛔ not a hand-assembled hunk. Gates: **BASE** = merge base, **HEAD0** = the FAILed head `b3944e3865`, **FIXED** = `fa8321b2fa`. Exit codes captured before any pipe.

| probe | BASE | HEAD0 | FIXED |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| F1 · acceptor lifted INTO its sibling `options: strictObject` bag, closer respelled ⇒ ONE block | 4 (1 row) | **0** | **4**, same row |
| F1 · mirror — sibling bag loses the acceptor, TOP level gains a strict bag of that name | 4 | **0** | **4** |
| F1 · indent-only — the hunk shows no enclosing opener at all | 4 | **0** | **4** |
| F1 · frames-only — two sibling bags at the SAME indent, different parents | 4 | **0** | **4** |
| CONTROL · the same move, closer UNTOUCHED ⇒ git emits TWO blocks | 2 rows | 2 rows | 2 rows |
| F2 · regex holds a brace open, then a brand-new key at the OUTER level | 4 (2 rows) | **0** | **4**, exactly **1** row — and it is the outer key; the genuine bag member stays declined |
| CONTROL · a single unmatched brace-escape · a balanced token regex | 1 row | 1 row | 1 row |
| F3 · spend path, wrapped acceptor removed from INSIDE a bag vs. the name declared at TOP level | 4 | **0** | **4** |
| F3 · the SAME pair at the SAME place | 4 | **0** | **0** — the disclosed, sound half is untouched |
| ⭐ THE LIVE PAIR — PR #19095's real diff, fetched from the API | **4** at `component.zod.ts:2689`, `:2692` | 0 | **0** |

⭐ The **frames-only** probe exists because the first three all differ in indentation and so pinned only that half of the place predicate.

Every shape above is now a `--self-test` case carrying the **git-emitted hunk body pasted verbatim**. `--self-test` → **563 cases pass, exit 0** (was 542); the `#19099` battery floor moved **32 → 53**.

## Ablation — nine legs, ⛔ none green

Each via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit; the write verified against the disk; restore proven by `blob == HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`), from the COMMITTED state.

| leg | mutation | self-test |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 1 | the same-path half dropped (`samePlace(...)` → `true`) | **6 / 563 FAIL** — both F1 shapes, frames-only, indent-only, and the spend path |
| 2 | the `unreadable` refusal dropped in the bag reading | **2 / 563** |
| 3 | the **indent** half of `samePlace` dropped | **2 / 563** |
| 4 | the **frames** half of `samePlace` dropped | **2 / 563** |
| 5 | absent path evidence made to restore the name-only reading | **1 / 563** |
| 6 | `framePlace` made to keep the frame's own-line openers | **16 / 563** — the live pair and every decline collapse, which is why those openers are dropped |
| 7 | the type-blind-pop flag dropped | 1 / 563 |
| 8 | the bare-slash flag dropped | 2 / 563 |
| 9 | **BOTH walker flags dropped together** | **4 / 563** |

⭐ **Legs 7 and 8 are NOT two independent pins, and this PR says so rather than presenting them as one each.** The F2 gate-level shape trips **both** rules, so neither single leg frees it — only the combined leg 9 does. Reported as one pin with two halves.

## No other tell moved

A corpus of the **250** newest non-merge commits on `origin/main`, full `git diff` bodies, swept through all three gates: **BASE 85 rows / HEAD0 83 / FIXED 83**. BASE vs FIXED differ on **exactly one** diff — `9bb059dbfe`, which is #19095 — and **HEAD0 vs FIXED are identical row for row on all 250**.

⚠️ **INSTRUMENT RADIUS for that zero:** 250 non-merge commits in a **shallow** clone (1,314 commits, 2026-09-06 through 2026-09-19), judged on the default board. **Known targets OUTSIDE it:** commits before 2026-09-06, merge commits, and objectui's mirror `packages/types/src/zod/**`, which this sweep does not read. ⛔ **0 of the 250 exhibit the F1 or F2 block shape at all**, so the corpus bounds the NOISE the repair could add and says **nothing** about the frequency of the leak.

## Verification

| check | result |
|:---|:---|
| `dispatch-gates --commands` → **29** families, reconciled with `--ran` | **29 derived, 29 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**, all exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:pm-clause2-carriers` (the sibling that IMPORTS `wideningRefusal` from this file) | exit 0, 942 cases |
| `check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 19153` | exit 0 |
| `eslint . --no-inline-config --format json` at `fa8321b2fa` | 6890 files, **0 errors, 0 warnings** |
| control bytes (`grep -naP`) over the edited file · `check:nul-bytes` | no match · exit 0 |
| this PR's own diff through the gate it edits | exit 0, and the script itself prints **NOT MEASURED** — `scripts/pm/**` is on no declared surface, so that zero is evidence about **no surface at all** |

## NOT MEASURED, declared

- **STALE TREE at derivation time.** The branch was 7 commits behind `origin/main` when the 29 families were derived, and 5 files the derivation reads changed in that range (`check-clause2-carriers`, `check-governed-merges`, `check-prior-rulings`, `check-skill-line-ratchet`, `dispatch-gates` itself). The branch was deliberately **not** merged, so the prior review's anchored readings keep their base. ⭐ **The seat re-derived on today's `origin/main` (`8b8258d910`) for this same change set and got 29 families — the same COUNT.** ⚠️ The seat compared counts only, ⛔ not the roster.
- CI convergence — not waited for.
- objectui's mirror under either matcher.
- Whether this file's **other** name-identity readings — `respellsExistingClosedSetKey`, `respellsExistingClosedSetBinding`, `rewritesExistingOpener` — carry the same limit. No probe was built. Unlike the bag decline each is bounded by #16943's one-unit-per-removed-line budget, so a surplus still fires.

## Acceptance notes

- The T2 control's case NAME now states what it measures: BASE reports **3** rows (the T1 opener `mode: z.enum([` plus the two elements), FIXED reports 2.
- The file header's gloss on the 7 refused sites is corrected: the refusal is the **wrapping ARGUMENT**, never where the step began. Of the 5 whose chain step's argument wraps, 4 open `.describe(` on the KEY line; the fifth, `automation/flow.zod.ts:211` (`defaultValue: z.unknown().optional()`), opens it on its **CONTINUATION** line. The count of 7 is unchanged and was re-measured independently (130 / 99 / 31 / 24 / 7).
- Noted, not filed: `enclosingDelimiters`'s regex blindness is now **FLAGGED, not fixed**. Carrier: the PR that takes the T2 overturn condition stated on `insideReplacedUniversalAcceptorBag`, or any that needs a decline to survive a regex.

## HISTORY — what this body used to claim, kept rather than deleted

⛔ Withdrawn, and recorded here because a correction that deletes its own subject is not a correction.

1. **Fact 2 stated as a NAME reading** — 「the same BLOCK removed that key carrying a universal acceptor」, with no requirement that the bag sit where the removed key sat. **REFUTED** by the at-tier review with three git-emitted diffs. The reading is now a PLACE.
2. **「Unlike every other decline in this file, this one leaves no 'but this member widens' case open」** — **FALSE as written**. It is true only under place identity; under the name identity the PR actually shipped, the open case was a bag at another path, and it was unbounded.
3. The ablation table's **2 / 542** and **6 / 542** readings were correct for the head they were taken on and are superseded by the nine-leg table above.
